deficiencies.description: The lecturer notes that biologists often explant tumours and then points to an image of a stained slice to examine morphology, without stating that the slice illustrates tumour explantation. The rewrite adds an unsourced link by asserting that the slice 'illustrates this'.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: often they will explant the tumor. Here you're looking at a slice through a tumor and a stain to look at the morphology.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: A slice through a tumour, with a stain to show the morphology, illustrates this [FIGURE].

considerations.sourcePassage: Primary cells really don't grow in culture. So when HeLa cells, which were the first tumor cells to grow in culture, did that, this was very much a surprise.
considerations.reason: The rewrite condenses the phrasing into 'HeLa cells were the first tumour cells to grow in culture, and so this was very much a surprise', which retains the causal context that their growth in culture was surprising because primary cells do not grow in culture.
